status: Proposed inspection boundaries, not validated replacements or traversal exclusions

entries.name: MapSL
entries.reason: Wine selector translation must be connected to our checked guest memory, not copied as a host-pointer implementation.

entries.name: MapLS
entries.reason: Exposing host data to a Win16 caller needs explicit guest-address and lifetime handling.

entries.name: get_dc_ptr
entries.reason: Inspect the required DC fields and lifetime assumptions against our host-owned context model.

entries.name: release_dc_ptr
entries.reason: Wine's acquisition/release contract belongs with the DC lookup adaptation.

entries.name: get_dc_attr
entries.reason: Returned Wine attributes are not interchangeable with our C# context; inspect fields used by each caller.

entries.name: stretch_bitmapinfo
entries.reason: Buffer-oriented scaling seam. Its indirect pixel-format helpers and state accesses remain part of the investigation.

entries.name: calc_1d_stretch_params
entries.reason: Coordinate and sampling calculations are candidates for adaptation and independent conformance tests.

entries.name: LocalAlloc16
entries.reason: Our local heap covers a limited contract. Consult Wine for missing flags/behavior without assuming our implementation covers every caller.

entries.name: GlobalAlloc16
entries.reason: Movable/global allocation semantics need to fit our segment and handle ownership; this is more than copying an allocator function.
